SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT

This Service Level Agreement applies to the hosted services that Corvid Cloud, Inc. ("Provider") provides to Aldine Freight Co. ("Customer") under the parties' Master Subscription Agreement.

1. Availability. Provider will make the service available 99.9% of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance.

2. Service Credits. If availability falls below 99.9%, Customer may claim a credit of 10% of the monthly subscription fees. Customer must request a credit within 30 days.

3. Sole Remedy. Service credits are Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for a failure to meet the availability commitment.

4. Support. Provider will respond to severity 1 incidents within one hour.
